To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference platform — scheduling

Hi Marissa,

Apologies — my travel schedule just changed and I need to reschedule the demo we had planned for next week. I'm on the road from 7/10–7/12 and won't have a reliable connection. Can we move the demo to the week of July 13? Ideally the team needs a session that allows time for a short prep run so your SEs can exercise our prompt types and workload traces against a small sample dataset.

Can you also share any recommended prompt sets or workload traces you typically use for an initial evaluation? We can provide a redacted sample of our data (I've attached the schema) and confirm any test account or SSO access you need.

Attaching: ACME_sample-data_schema.csv

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ramos
Sr. Product Manager, Acme Health
elena@acmehealth.com

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and the schema. No problem — we can move the demo into the week of 7/13.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 7/13 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT (preferred)
- Wed 7/14 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT

To make the live demo as useful as possible, our SE (looping in Dev Patel) will prepare a prompt set and synthetic workload traces based on the schema you attached. To avoid surprises on the day of the demo, can we do a 30-min tech check 30 minutes before the demo (to validate test account access, dataset upload, and any routing rules)?

I attached a short agenda for the session (what we'll cover + prep checklist) and will share a Drive folder for sample prompts and traces once we confirm time. If you can confirm which slot works and whether you can provide a small redacted sample (CSV or JSONL) we can begin prepping immediately.

Attaching: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks,

I've attached example files to show the format.

Quick requests to help us prep:

- Do you want us to use any specific quality/temperature settings for conditioning?
- Can you provide a test account and any SSO or token we should use for dataset upload/testing, or should we use an isolated demo account we create on your behalf?

Proposed tech-check: Tue 7/13 at 9:30 AM PT (30 min) — we'll verify dataset upload, keys, and the demo routing policies.
